101430.synopsis:
Duke Fernan Lowell, the Arke Empire’s greatest fighter pilot and legendary ace.
While preparing a rebellion against the cruel Emperor Dietrich, he meets a tragic end and is reincarnated as Diana Green, an orphaned girl in the neighboring country of Bringham.
All Diana ever wanted was to live a simple, peaceful life with her loved ones, but the Arke Empire sets its sights on invading Bringham once again…
She joins the fighter squadron and encounters Richard Ashwood, Bringham’s next-generation ace pilot.
“If you came here expecting to be treated like a porcelain doll, you’d better leave now.”
Diana clashes with the sharp-tongued and difficult Richard at every turn. Yet, over time, Richard finds himself increasingly obsessed with her.
“Sometimes, I don’t know whether I want to strangle you or hold you in my arms.”
On the day all the secrets of her past and reincarnation come to light, Diana must make a single, life-changing decision.
???
Of course, Richard had no intention of excusing his own vulgarity. If Diana even caught a glimpse of what lay beneath his exterior, she’d have every right to be terrified. His mind was brimming with every kind of insane thought imaginable.
Right now, he wanted nothing more than to tear Diana Green’s dress to shreds and claim her. He wanted to possess her entirely—her warmth, the scent of her perfume lingering near her earlobes, her quickened breaths, the very beat of her heart.
Richard’s eyes lingered on Diana’s collarbone, shoulders, and the curve of her nape, all revealed by the cut of her dress. Her green eyes, trying so hard to hide her unease, looked like strawberries perched atop a cream cake. It was a mad thought, but he wanted to taste her.
He admitted it again to himself.
“I lust after Diana Green.”
He wanted to explore her inside and out, to see how she would respond. This desire was far stronger and deeper than any physical craving he had ever felt for others before. It burned within him, consuming him entirely.
It was no surprise that Diana was afraid of him.
“But I won’t let her run away.”
He pressed his lips against the back of Diana’s gloved hand, as though signing a contract with red ink.
The gesture was firm and resolute.

102198.synopsis:

103990.synopsis:
Kang I-bom.
Kang I-bom is from the Kang family of dogs.
But he’s not actually a real dog.
He was born with the blood of a dog beastman, yet he’s not a full-fledged beastman.
In other words, he’s a half-blood (반수인).
A half-blood, forever caught in between. Neither fully human nor fully beastman.
I-bom’s life isn’t easy.
Amidst his busy, never-ending shifts at his part-time jobs, he unexpectedly encounters an enormous cat one day.
Since it’s his first time seeing a real cat, he can’t help but feel excited. With his heart fluttering, he cautiously approaches the feline and speaks to it…
* * *
‘What’s your name, pretty one?”
I-bom whispers softly, meeting the cat’s gaze as he blinks slowly.
“Weoong?”
The cat responds with a sound.
At that moment, a phrase from a documentary about beastman wildlife pops into his head.
‘If you don’t understand an animal’s language, try repeating the sound they make.’
Ah! That’s it!
“We… oong?”
When I-bom gently repeats the sound, the cat’s lazily swaying tail suddenly halts.
Meanwhile…
‘…What?’
Eun Beom-ho’s black pupils sharpened as they glinted dangerously.
He had playfully swayed his tail first, but he never expected such an intense reaction in return.
‘Weoong.’
That word was… bold.
Shocking.
Scandalous.
In fact, according to Sacred Beast Wiki, it was ranked as the #1 phrase that young, underage beastmen should never say.
‘Weoong’ and ‘Weong’ were completely different.
‘Weong’ meant something casual, like “Damn it.”
‘Weoong’, however, meant “Let’s mate.”
“Your name… So, you’re ‘Weoong’?”
Oh my god.
Did this bold little pup just ask to mate again?
Since he was so insistent, Beom-ho figured it was only polite to respond in kind.
“Waaark.”
Yes. Let’s do it. I like you too.
This adorable little pup, with his warm, irresistible scent, smelled utterly delicious to him.

107830.synopsis:

“Sometimes I just don’t understand you.”

134710.synopsis:
Everyone at the hospital knows that Lu Jiahe’s medical skill is beyond reproach. Not only is he handsome, but he’s also incredibly gentle and patient with his patients. Lately, however, a single patient has been causing him a great deal of anxiety and stress.

“I’m not interested in dating you. And I’m definitely not getting married.”
“What if I’m confident I can make you… like me?”
When Ji-hyeok finally realised how he felt about Eun-young, he decided it didn’t matter why she approached him. Whether it was for money or to become the wife of the Yoonil Group chairman, he was ready to give her whatever she wanted.
With that resolve, he slipped the ring onto her finger. Even if that was all she wanted from him, he wanted to marry her. He wanted to spend the rest of his life with her. That’s how much he liked her. It was a first for him—feeling this way about someone.
It started from the moment she boldly claimed she could make him fall for her. No… actually, it was even earlier. It was that day, during the family event, when he first saw her in that empty hallway.

181046.synopsis:
Jiang Qunyu transmigrated into a melodramatic cultivation novel and became the inner demon of the villain, Wei Xun.
In the original book, Wei Xun was originally a breathtakingly brilliant young genius of the Lingxiao Sect. However, during a trial, his meridians were completely destroyed by demonic energy while saving his fellow disciples. Falling from the clouds into the mud, his fiancée broke off their engagement, his fellow disciples bullied him, and his relatives betrayed him. He eventually became the mad Demon Venerable who terrified the cultivation world, and was finally jointly killed by the protagonist top and bottom.
Of course, as the villain’s inner demon opposing the protagonist top and bottom, what good ending could he possibly have? Naturally, he would also dissipate into thin air along with the villain.
Jiang Qunyu: …Whoever wants to be this broken inner demon can be it!

213302.synopsis:
Gu Yunci transmigrated into a novel—as the villainous husband in a reborn-wife revenge story.
In the original plot, the heroine, Su Muyue, devoted everything to the Marquis’s household, only to be betrayed and poisoned by her husband, Gu Yunci, and her half-sister.
After being reborn, Su Muyue changes her fate on the spot. On her wedding day, she abandons Gu Yunci and marries the hidden true male lead instead.
As for Gu Yunci? He should have become the stepping stone trampled beneath their rise.
Instead, he awakens the Break Their Defenses System.
As long as he makes someone lose their composure, he earns outrageous rewards.
The reborn heroine wants to watch him fall? He rises faster than ever.
The hidden big shot wants to keep playing the underdog? Gu Yunci crushes him head-on.
The whole capital waits to laugh at Gu Yunci and the “vicious” girl everyone despises?
Too bad—he’s already spoiled her into the sky.
In a world where everyone thinks he’s the villain, Gu Yunci decides to stop pretending otherwise.
If they want a troublemaker, he’ll become the one none of them can handle.
